questions.question: What was the major purpose of the ‘permit license raj’ from the 1960s to 1980s in India?

options.text: Government allowing nationalised banks to lend to private companies
Government allowing public sector undertakings to produce goods
Government allowing only foreign companies to sell goods in India
Government allowing private companies to produce goods

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Government allowing private companies to produce goods. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Permit License Raj:-**

 
 
• **The Permit License Raj was a system of extensive government regulation and control over the Indian economy from the 1950s to the early 1990s. **
 
• It was characterized by a web of regulations, permits, and licenses that businesses had to obtain in order to operate.
 
• The system was intended to protect Indian industry, promote self-reliance, and ensure regional equality.
 
• However, it also led to widespread corruption, inefficiency, and a stifling of economic growth. 
 
• **The major purpose of the ‘permit license raj’ from the 1960s to 1980s in India was that the Government allowing private companies to produce goods.** 
 
• **Key features of the Permit License Raj:**
 
 
• Businesses had to obtain licenses from the government for everything from starting a new company to expanding an existing one.
 
• The government also controlled the prices of many goods and services.
 
• Imports were heavily restricted, and businesses were often required to use Indian-made products, even if they were of inferior quality.
 
• The Permit License Raj was a major obstacle to economic development in India. It led to widespread corruption, inefficiency, and a stifling of innovation.

questions.question: In which of the following conditions is there severe physical and mental retardation due to deficiency of iodine and thyroid hormones, especially during early pregnancy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cretinism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cretinism**:-

 
 
• **It is a severe form of iodine deficiency disorder (IDD) that can cause irreversible physical and mental retardation.**
 
• **Cretinism is most commonly caused by iodine deficiency during pregnancy and early infancy.**
 
• Iodine is a trace element that is essential for the production of thyroid hormones.
 
• Thyroid hormones are important for the normal development of the brain and nervous system.
 
• If a pregnant woman or a young child does not get enough iodine, it can lead to a deficiency of thyroid hormones, which can cause cretinism.
 
• Symptoms of cretinism can include:-
 
 
• Severe mental retardation
 
• Stunted growth
 
• Deafness
 
• Mutism
 
• Spasticity
 
• Goiter (enlarged thyroid gland)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Preeclampsia**:-

 
 
• **It is a pregnancy complication characterized by high blood pressure and protein in the urine after 20 weeks of pregnancy. **
 
• It can lead to serious health problems for both mother and baby, including seizures, liver and kidney damage, and premature birth.
 
 
 
• **Toxoplasmosis**:-
 
 
• **It is an infection caused by a parasite called Toxoplasma gondii. **
 
• It can be spread through contact with infected cats or their feces, contaminated meat, or unwashed fruits and vegetables.
 
• While most people who are infected with Toxoplasma gondii never experience any symptoms, it can cause serious birth defects if a woman is infected during pregnancy.
 
 
 
• **Syphilis**:-
 
 
• **It is a sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum. **
 
• It can be spread through contact with open sores on the skin or mucous membranes.
 
• While syphilis can be cured with antibiotics, it can cause serious birth defects if a woman is infected during pregnancy.

• **Oxygen**:-

• Oxygen is essential for respiration, the process by which organisms convert food into energy.
 
• It is also involved in photosynthesis, the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy. Oxygen is also used in many industrial applications, such as the production of steel and glass.
 
 
 
• **Chlorine**:-

questions.question: What is a one act play of Sattriya called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ankiya Nat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ankiya Nat:-**

 
 
• **A one-act play of Sattriya is called an Ankiya Nat. It is a form of Assamese one-act play that combines the aesthetic and the religious.**
 
• Ankiya Nats were developed by Sankardev, the 15th-century polymath from Assam, as a way to promote the spiritual values of Vaisnavism.
 
• They are typically performed in Sattras, which are communities of live-in devotees belonging to the Ekasarana dharma, the religion established by Sankardev.
 
• Ankiya Nats are characterized by their use of ballad, dance, and drama. The ballad narrates the story, the dance provides commentary and expression, and the drama brings the characters and themes to life.
 
• The plays are often based on stories from Hindu mythology, but they can also deal with contemporary social and political issues.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ekam Nat:-**

 
 
• Ekam Nat, meaning "one-act play," is a short, self-contained play that typically focuses on a single theme or character.
 
• It is often used as a teaching tool or for entertainment.
 
 
 
• **Vishesham Nat:-**
 
 
• Vishesham Nat, meaning "special play," is a longer and more complex type of Sattriya play.
 
• It typically deals with a historical or mythological story. Vishesham Nats are often performed at festivals and special occasions.
 
 
 
• **Anant Nat:-**
 
 
• Anant Nat, meaning "endless play," is a type of Sattriya play that has no predetermined ending.
 
• The play continues until the audience loses interest or the performers are exhausted. Anant Nats are often improvised and can be very humorous.

questions.question: In the concept of money supply, M4 refers to ________.

options.text: M1+ time deposits of the public with banks

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**M3+ total post office deposits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M4:-**

 
 
• **It includes all of the components of M3 plus other deposits with an original maturity of up to five years, other claims on financial institutions such as repos and bank acceptances, and debt instruments issued by financial institutions including commercial paper and bonds with a maturity of up to five years.**
 
• M4 is a broad measure of the money supply because it includes a wide range of assets that can be easily converted into cash. This makes it a useful measure for tracking the overall liquidity of the economy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Different money supply in India:-
 
 
• **M0:-**

 
 
• It is the narrowest measure of money supply and consists of currency notes and coins in circulation plus reserve balances with the RBI. 
 
 
 
• **M1:-**
 
 
• It is a broader measure of money supply and consists of M0 plus demand deposits with banks. 
 
 
 
• **M2:-**
 
 
• It is an even broader measure of money supply and consists of M1 plus savings deposits with banks. 
 
 
 
• **M3:-**
 
 
• It is the broadest measure of money supply and consists of M2 plus time deposits with banks.

• **Human Chromosomes:-**

 
 
• Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes in each cell, for a total of 46 chromosomes.
 
• These chromosomes are organized into two main types:-
 
 
• **Autosomes**: The first 22 pairs of chromosomes are called autosomes. They are not involved in sex determination.
 
• **Sex chromosomes:** The 23rd pair of chromosomes is called the sex chromosomes. These chromosomes determine an individual's sex. Females typically have two X chromosomes (XX), while males typically have one X chromosome and one Y chromosome (XY).

(ii) Money supply is a flow concept

(iii) M1 is the most liquid measure of money supply
questions.solution:

• ** Money supply:-**

 
 
• **Money supply is a stock concept, meaning it represents the total amount of money available at a specific point in time.**
 
• It is not a flow concept, which would measure the quantity of money moving over a period of time.
 
• M1 is indeed the most liquid measure of money supply, as it includes only the most readily accessible forms of money, such as currency and checking deposits.
 
• Broader measures of money supply, such as M2 and M3, include less liquid assets, such as savings deposits and money market funds.

• This is known as Boyle's Law, after Robert Boyle, who had independently discovered the same relationship in 1662.
 
 
 
• **Jacques Charles:-**
 
 
• **He was a French physicist and mathematician who is best known for his work on the relationship between the volume and temperature of gases. **

• **Structural geology:-**

 
 
• **It deals with the the form, classification, mechanism, and causes of rock structures’ evolution.**
 
• It seeks to understand how rocks have been deformed by forces such as plate tectonics, impact events, and volcanic activity.
 
• **Structural geologists use a variety of techniques to study rocks, including field observations, laboratory experiments, and computer modeling.**
 
• Some of the key topics in structural geology include:
 
 
• **Folds**: Folds are curved rock layers that form when rocks are compressed.
 
• **Faults**: Faults are fractures in rocks along which there has been displacement.
 
• **Joints**: Joints are fractures in rocks that do not show any displacement.
 
• **Cleavage**: Cleavage is a planar fabric in rocks that develops as a result of deformation.
 
• **Foliation**: Foliation is a general term for any planar fabric in rocks.
 
• **Lineation**: Lineation is a linear fabric in rocks that develops as a result of deformation.

questions.question: What is the height of the troposphere near the poles and the equator, respectively?

• **Troposphere:-**

 
 
• **The troposphere is the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere. **
 
• It is the densest layer of the atmosphere, containing about 75% of the total mass of the atmosphere and 99% of the total mass of water vapor.
 
• **The height of the troposphere varies with latitude, being lowest at the poles (about 8 kilometers or 5 miles) and highest at the equator (about 18 kilometers or 11 miles).**
 
• This is because the Earth receives more solar radiation at the equator, which heats the air and causes it to expand and rise.
 
• The rising air cools as it expands, and this process continues until the air reaches the tropopause, the boundary between the troposphere and the stratosphere. The tropopause is marked by a sharp decrease in temperature with height.

• It moves two squares in one direction, then one square perpendicular to that direction. This movement pattern is unique to the knight and makes it a very versatile piece. 
 
• The knight is also the only piece that can jump over other pieces.
 
• This means that it can attack pieces that are on squares between its starting position and its destination. This makes the knight a very powerful piece, especially in crowded positions.

• The king can move one square in any direction.
 
 
 
• **Queen: **
 
 
• The most powerful piece on the board.
 
• The queen can move any number of squares in any direction (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally).
 
 
 
• **Rook:**
 
 
• A very strong piece that can move any number of squares horizontally or vertically.
